phrases.chunkLabel: WH-question + be-verb (recycled question formation from A1.1) — NOT a there-is/are construction. LINT FINDING: this situation's attached grammar target (gr_a1_there_is_are) has no real backing phrase anywhere in its item bank (checked: excuse_me, where_is_the, i_dont_understand, can_you_repeat, go_straight, turn_left, next_to — none is a genuine 'there is/are' sentence). Surfaced by building this lint tool against real shipped content, not by the V2 master-plan audit (which only covered newly-planned situations). Flagged for the user to decide a fix; content not changed in Phase 0 per 'production не трогать'.

Present Perfect ('been' = participle of existential 'there has been', not a passive marker — see CONTENT_MASTER_PLAN_A1_B2_V2.md §11 fix #2) — fixed functional phrase for reporting an error, not decomposed at A1. Real target deferred to B1.8 (storytelling / experience).
